claims.text: IRGM acts as an adaptor that promotes co-assembly of ULK1 and BECN1 in human macrophages.
IRGM is required for autophagy in all human cell types.
IRGM is associated with Crohn's disease.
Loss of IRGM causes Crohn's disease in humans.
IRGM limits inflammation through mitophagy in human patients.
